groups.activity: own a Railjack or crew slot; rank Intrinsics for the target node

rows.label: own Railjack or a crew slot

conditions: Korm's Belt (Earth Proxima) needs no Intrinsics gate, but its Galleon only spawns on some loads — check the objective list before committing.
bonuses: Killing the captain rush-style still earns roughly 1 Intrinsic point per kill, so this farm doubles as progress toward the Intrinsics 7 gate.

groups.sub: Asteroid Base, always spawns a commander
groups.activity: rush to the commander, kill, check the drop, abort if nothing
conditions: Loot abilities (Desecrate, Pilfering Swarm, Prowl, Ore Gaze, Pilfering Strangledome, Retrieve) don't work on these targets — there's no double-dip.
Rush the target and check the drop; abort immediately if it doesn't drop, since fighter/crewship objectives don't matter for this farm.
bonuses: Quellor's blueprint rolls on the same kill, so you're farming both weapons at once.
Killing the captain gives roughly 1 Intrinsic point even on an abort.

disclosures.title: other nodes
disclosures.body: Flexa (Veil Proxima) always has a Galleon too, needs Intrinsics 7 and the Chimera Prologue, enemies level 80-90. Korm's Belt (Earth Proxima) has easier level 24-30 enemies and no Intrinsics gate, but its Galleon only spawns on about 40% of loads — check the objective list at load-in and abort to reroll if there's no captain.

rows.label: Pennant

conditions: Tellurium is the only ingredient here you might not already have stockpiled; the rest are common resources.
